author: blu
body: Proves the AI taps mana sources before casting. A Llanowar Elves in play (not summoning-sick) is tapped for {G}; a freshly-cast Elf (summoning-sick) is left alone, because a creature's {T} ability needs the sickness to wear off; a Mox Pearl is an artifact, has no summoning sickness, and taps for {W} the turn it lands. So the ramp is real and the sickness rule is honoured.
